subject: Proposed City Charter and Rezoning Review
overview: City Council candidate Patrick Clerkin discussed his positions on citywide rezoning, the upcoming charter reform ballot question, and the future of the high school. He advocated for ward-based representation and increased neighborhood participation in large-scale municipal decisions.

items.title: Rezoning and Neighborhood Impacts
items.summary: Patrick Clerkin advocated for comprehensive rezoning that incorporates neighborhood impact studies on traffic, parking, and utilities to ensure residents do not feel excluded from the process.

items.title: City Charter Reform Proposal
items.summary: Clerkin expressed support for the ballot initiative to expand the City Council to 11 members with ward-based representation, noting it would mandate annual budget meetings and regular charter reviews.

items.title: High School Renovation and Funding
items.summary: Clerkin addressed the high school building project, stating that the city must learn from past rezoning mistakes by properly including residents in the choice between renovation and new construction.
